name: What are the common signs of a water heater leak?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of a water heater leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of a water heater leak include visible puddles of water around the base of the unit, dripping sounds, reduced hot water supply, or discolored (rusty) hot water. You might also notice a sudden increase in your water bill or a musty odor if the leak has been present for a while. It's important to act quickly if you notice these signs, as even small leaks can lead to significant water damage over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for puddles, dripping sounds, reduced hot water, rusty water, or a higher water bill. Early detection prevents major damage.
